meta.name: Kabisa Storefront
meta.description: Warm, editorial B2B healthcare commerce. A sibling of the established Kabisa admin identity.
source_references: UI/UX Pro Max healthcare and ecommerce guidance
Local browser checks; generated editorial healthcare still life

color.palette_type: Kabisa teal with warm ivory and quiet botanical tints
rules: Deep teal 700/800 for actions and small text. Teal 500 is decorative.
Semantic labels include words or icons; never color alone.
No fabricated stock counts, scarcity, reviews or facility statistics.

layout.product_grid: 2 columns on phones; 3–4 on wider screens; catalog filters collapse on small screens

components: Native Expo screens and tab navigation

design_style.composition: Large display typography and genuine product information, offset by a decorative unbranded still life. Compact, explicit actions on buying paths.
design_style.imagery: Generated hero is identified as illustrative. Inventory imagery comes only from product records; missing photographs use a clearly generic fallback.
design_style.surfaces: Warm ivory hero, white commerce cards, fine borders and restrained shadows. No ornamental dashboard glass effects.
design_style.trust: Company TIN/licence and office contacts from existing settings; TMDA registration and prescription flags from products; account verification and real order status.

visual_effects.route_transition: Small opacity/position changes; global reduced-motion preference respected.
visual_effects.marketing: GSAP + Lenis are loaded only on the home route and gated by reduced motion, connection and device capability.
visual_effects.feedback: One-shot Lottie confirmation; subtle product hover and native press feedback.
visual_effects.loading: Web skeletons; native activity indicators for live requests.
visual_effects.webgl: Omitted to preserve the commerce performance budget.
visual_effects.accessibility: Disable nonessential motion on reduced motion; keyboard focus visible; native labels and 44px touch controls.

budgets.note: Targets require measurement on the deployed service; local verification evidence is recorded separately.
